'''Barik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He had a shop on [[Carrick Station]], where he sold [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barik appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]], as the Speeder vendor on Carrick Station.<ref name="TOR" />
